notes: Seven previously uncontacted technical recruiting founders with Hunter-valid company-domain emails.
No URLs or tracking links are included. Recipients can find Hirelix through Google when the need is relevant.
The copy introduces what Hirelix provides without asking for a JD, trial task, reply, or product feedback.
Every email states the business relevance and includes an opt-out plus mailing-address placeholder.
Final sending requires recipient and copy confirmation plus configured sender and postal address.

emails.subject: AI sourcing and screening for Scale-Ability
emails.body:
Hi Neil,

I'm Noah, founder of Hirelix. We built it for technical recruiters who want to spend less time on repetitive sourcing and initial profile review.

Hirelix uses parallel AI agents to search and assess real technical profiles at scale, including LinkedIn profiles. The agents understand each profile in the context of the role, evaluate the available evidence, and rank the strongest candidates.

For promising candidates, Hirelix can go beyond LinkedIn and research public evidence across the web, such as open-source projects, patents, published papers, technical writing, and conference talks when available. Recruiters receive a ranked candidate pool with fit reasons, risks to verify, and editable outreach drafts.

Scale-Ability's focus on AI/ML and software roles made me think this could be relevant to your work.

We are currently opening Hirelix to a small group of seed users in technical recruiting. If you have an active or upcoming technical search where this could be useful, you can first Google "Hirelix AI recruiting" to see how it works. If it looks relevant, simply reply "interested" and I'll arrange early access.

Best,
Noah

If this is not relevant, reply "opt out" and I will not email again.
Mailing address: {{MAILING_ADDRESS_REQUIRED_BEFORE_SEND}}
